gold.user: A project manager looking to retrieve the workflow scheme associated with a specific project in Jira to ensure that the correct processes are being followed.
gold.ideal: Retrieve the workflow scheme associated with the specified project, including details about the workflows and their statuses.

gold.user: A Jira administrator who needs to assign a new workflow scheme to a project to improve the efficiency of the team's workflow and adapt to recent changes in project requirements.
gold.ideal: Successfully assign the specified workflow scheme to the project, updating the project's configuration to reflect the new workflows.
